description.value: Tulip Donair is a Mediterranean and pizza restaurant in Chilliwack specializing in donairs — lamb, beef, chicken, and vegetarian falafel — alongside pizzas, salads, and poutines. The restaurant operates a streamlined online pickup ordering system, making it a practical quick-stop option for cyclists moving through the area. A kids' menu and a range of vegetarian items round out the offering for mixed groups.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the business is active with a full online ordering system for pickup. The website corroborates the OSM address (45641 Lark Rd) and provides a phone number (+1 604-846-7669) not present in OSM.
